description: DiligenceOps: submit a data retention and deletion policy. The signed report lists each data class the policy names (account data, payment records, logs, backups, communications, analytics and more) with its retention period, a period stated only as "as long as necessary", or none, and marks the deletion method, the deletion timeline after a request and stated exceptions present, missing or ambiguous, with quotes. POST /api/data-retention-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-disclosure-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the policy, recorded in the report.

policy.description: The data retention and deletion policy, or the retention section of a privacy policy, up to 256 KB.
